$comment: Staleness lock. `pnpm capture:check` compares these against the live Figma file and fails when it has moved, so a manual-capture chain cannot silently rot.
$versionNote: The Figma Plugin API exposes neither file version nor file name; capture:check reads version from the REST API, which needs FIGMA_TOKEN. Set that secret and run `pnpm capture:check` once to populate version/lastModified.
